method: Codex built-in image generation through installed image tool; bounded mineral-pigment transfer using add_mark19.js.
review: Local full-wall visual inspection plus PNG/JPEG structural inspection and exact ancestor pixel comparison.
ancestral_marks: All pixels outside the added pigment remain unchanged; no existing painted motif intersects the destination box.
hands: Both inherited hands have four fingers and one thumb; five digits each. No hands or stencils added.
look: Warm square rough cave rock, cracks, lighting and framing preserved. Pepe retains heavy-lidded eyes and wide mouth.
prohibited_content: No letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, real people, political or hateful symbols observed.
limitations: Small motif loses fine detail at 512 pixels.
Local review is not independent visual approval.
